L’intention devient
un terrain de jeu
fr.heroDescription: Imaginer des espaces, leur donner du sens, les mettre à l’épreuve du joueur. Du level design au moteur, avec un regard QA et production.

fr.projectsIntro: Des univers différents, un même fil conducteur : transformer une intention en expérience jouable, avec l’équipe.

Du premier croquis
à la version jouable

fr.contactNote: Échanges en français ou en anglais

en.description: Level Designer with a QA and production perspective. Projects, case studies and development notes by Nathan Tandille.
en.heroTitle:
From an intention
to a place to play
en.heroDescription: Imagine spaces, give them purpose, put them in players’ hands. From level design to the engine, with a QA and production perspective.
en.heroNote: A portfolio, and the thinking behind it
en.projectsIntro: Different worlds, one common thread: turning an intention into a playable experience, together with the team.
en.journalIntro: Design decisions, real-world problems, methods and experiments. The work behind the projects.
en.skillsIntro: Design, test, move things forward. Complementary skills, illustrated by concrete work.
en.aboutTitle:
From the first sketch
to a playable experience
en.aboutText: I work on level design close to the engine, the systems and the players. My QA and production background helps connect design intentions to real constraints: readability, pacing, feasibility and iteration.
en.contactText: A role, an idea, a design or production question. The simplest way to reach me is by email.
